subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a repaired 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first product slice, or require a broader daily/week calendar design before implementation?
rationale: The remaining work is a Control UI product shape decision, not a broken existing behavior contract, and the open PR covers only part of the requested calendar/timeline scope.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase and repair the linked PR, preserve current cron contracts, and accept the 24-hour timeline as an intentional first slice while tracking or rejecting broader day/week/editing scope separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause the linked PR and define the daily, weekly, stats, and drag-and-drop editing behavior before accepting implementation.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR after documenting that the current list/run-history UI is sufficient for core.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase and repair the linked PR, preserve current cron contracts, and accept the 24-hour timeline as an intentional first slice while tracking or rejecting broader day/week/editing scope separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has prior review context on this issue and relevant Control UI product history, making him the best available routing owner for the product-scope decision.
